mechanism: Ampicillin may reduce gut motility and alter gastric emptying, potentially affecting semaglutide absorption and efficacy; semaglutide's delayed gastric emptying may increase ampicillin exposure in the GI tract.
action: Monitor blood glucose control and ampicillin efficacy; consider staggered dosing or alternative antibiotic if GI symptoms develop; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
